Before television made him a major Serbian media proprietor, Mitrović played bass in a Belgrade rock group and converted his interest in music into a commercial recording operation. He then moved into radio and launched a national commercial television network. This progression gave him control over both the production and distribution of popular entertainment, establishing the business foundation for later expansion.

The Pink organisation added a record label, film and television production facilities, streaming services and other digital operations around the broadcast core. The corporate balance sheet and revenue belong to the business and do not establish his personal net worth. Although the wider organisation has pursued aviation and engineering ventures, broadcasting remains the central documented source and present sector of his wealth.
